title: Minute-bucket suppression in mesh routing aggregation causing unattributed usage in private clusters
creator: Nadia Chen
description:
Summary: A high-severity customer escalation reported missing usage lines in monthly invoices for Private deployments behind our mesh router. The missing usage corresponds to short-lived minute-granularity request bursts that were suppressed during an internal aggregation pass, resulting in unattributed tokens and underbilling for affected tenants. Affected environments: customer-managed Private clusters (on-prem and VPC) using mesh routing + proxy aggregation.

Timeline:
- 2026-03-10 08:43 - Escalation opened by ACME Corp support (billing undercount ~7% for Feb).
- 2026-03-10 11:00 - Initial triage by on-call infra (confirmed undercount pattern in private-exported ledger vs runtime logs).
- 2026-03-11 14:20 - Reproduced locally with stress harness (short bursts in same-minute buckets cause aggregation to drop per-tenant lines).
- 2026-03-12 09:00 - Root cause narrowed to mesh router aggregation pass where minute-bucket suppression incorrectly collapsed zero-duration streams after compression step.

Root cause (technical): The mesh router's aggregation pipeline attempts to compress micro-bursts into minute buckets for export to the accounting pipeline. A recent optimization (runtime-1.22) introduced a deduplication step that de-duplicated consecutive zero-duration entries under the assumption they were replay artifacts. In hybrid private routing, some tenants legitimately produce 1-2 zero-duration entries that carry distinct token attributions via metadata headers. The dedupe step removed those lines and the subsequent exporter emitted a single aggregated bucket without per-tenant attribution, causing the ledger to show lower per-customer token counts while global totals appeared consistent.

Reproduction steps:
1) Deploy a local private cluster with mesh router + proxy aggregation enabled.
2) Run stress harness: scripts/fixtures/burst_emulator.sh --pattern=minute_smite --burst-size=1 --tenant=acme-test.
3) Observe exporter CSV: /tmp/exported-ledger.csv, compare runtime trace logs: /tmp/trace-acme.log.

Mitigation (short term):
- Disabled dedupe optimization in mesh router on affected customer clusters (config toggle mesh.aggregation.dedupe=false). Applied to ACME private cluster via remote-runbook at 2026-03-11 17:30 (rollback available).
- Triggered backfill reconcile job to lift minute buckets into per-tenant lines for Feb and Mar. Backfill job id: BACKFILL-2026-03-11-ACME (ran successfully; staged ledger patch ready for billing review).

Fix plan (long term):
- Update aggregation pipeline to preserve per-entry metadata keys even when compression is applied (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3245).
- Add strict unit/integration tests covering: multiple zero-duration entries with distinct tenant headers, exporter fidelity, and private mesh routing scenarios.
- Validate exporter alignment with metering ledger schemas and add end-to-end CI that compares exported CSV with token-level traces for randomized bursts.

Rollout strategy:
- Merge fix to runtime-1.22 branch behind feature flag mesh.aggregation.fidelity=true.
- Canary in hosted staging (5% of traffic) and two private customer sandboxes for 48 hours.
- Gradual ramp to 100% with automated reconciliation check gating each step.

Monitoring & Validation:
- New dashboards added: Billing/Exports/Unattributed_Tokens (Grafana panel) and Reconciliation_Delta (Datadog monitor).
- Alert: Reconciliation delta > 0.5% for any tenant within 24h triggers pager.

Stakeholders & comms:
- Customer contacts: ACME billing (sarah.jenkins@acme.example), ACME infra lead (mike.choi@acme.example).
- Sales/Customer Success update scheduled: 2026-03-13 10:00PT (owner: Priya Rao).
- Confluence incident notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/PRIV-ACME-Mesh-Aggregation-Incident.

Next steps (this ticket):
- Finish code change and unit tests (owner: Liam).
- Land PR and run canary (owner: infra-release).
- Complete backfill validation and hand off to billing for final invoice adjustments (owner: Finance Ops).
- Postmortem and permanent dashboarding for similar patterns.
